newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Blaze causes huge damage at Colombia car plant.
newsitem.headline: Blaze causes huge damage at Colombia car plant.

text.p: A stray Christmas decoration started a fire that caused about $10 million of damage at Colombia's third largest vehicle assembly plant, the company chairman said Thursday.

The blaze broke out late Christmas day in the Sociedad de Fabricacion Automotriz SA (Sofasa) in the northwest city of Medellin after a homemade paper balloon, powered by a gasoline burner -- a traditional decoration at this time of year -- fell through the skylight of a warehouse at the plant.
"Preliminary estimates suggest that the overall cost of the damage, mostly autoparts imported from Japan and France, is in excess of $10 million," company head Ricardo Obregon said.
Sofasa, part of the Santo Domingo industrial conglomerate, assembles Renault vehicles and the Toyota Motor Corp Hilux 4x4. ((-- Juan Guillermo Londono, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
